notes: Paul Black is Co-CEO and portfolio manager at WCM Investment Management, a $26 billion manager of global equities that he joined when it was a $200 million boutique in 1989. With so much of the institutional world, including my own training, focused on value investing, I was pleasantly surprised to learn about a large, high performing growth stock manager located in a non-descript building in Laguna Beach, California. Our conversation starts with Paul's trial-by-fire entry into the business and turns to growth stock investing, including defining a great growth company, searching for widening moats, assessing a culture tied to competitive advantage, creating a positive culture, learning from mistakes, identifying tailwinds, and protecting the downside. Paul embodies the principals he preaches and offers some tasty food for thought.  Paul Black is Co-CEO and portfolio manager at WCM Investment
Management, a $26 billion manager of global equities that he joined
when it was a $200 million boutique in 1989.  With so much of
the institutional world, including my own training, focused on
value investing, I was pleasantly surprised to learn about a large,
high performing growth stock manager located in a non-descript
building in Laguna Beach, California.

 
 

Our conversation starts with Paul’s trial-by-fire entry into the
business and turns to growth stock investing, including defining a
great growth company, searching for widening moats, assessing a
culture tied to competitive advantage, creating a positive culture,
learning from mistakes, identifying tailwinds, and protecting the
downside.

 
 

Paul embodies the principals he preaches and offers some tasty food
for thought.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
